probability.title: Probability disclosure
probability.disclaimer: Rates are box-level (basis points shown as percent). Actual draws follow server inventory and rules. Changes are logged. After payment, verify draws in order details via seed/hash check. Users under 18 cannot purchase. Spend responsibly. Confirm draw count and amount before paying; random virtual goods are non-refundable except for quality issues. Questions: submit feedback under Profile — reply within 3 business days.
